relevance.why: Design quality is the usual weak spot of Claude Code-built apps; a design-system skill is exactly the kind of reusable asset a solo founder should keep in the skills folder.

implement_score.why: Cheap to try once the repo is identified (likely an Apple HIG / Liquid Glass skill in awesome-claude-skills); install as a Claude Code skill and A/B a landing page. Risk of looking like an Apple clone and of trademark issues on the dress.
